lessons.title: Doers of the Word
lessons.imageAlt: Martin Schongauer — The Battle of Saint James at Clavijo (c. 1470–75), full landscape engraving, National Gallery of Art, public domain
lessons.quote: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
lessons.lesson: James is not collecting listeners. Hearing the word and stopping there is self-deception. The man who looks at his face in a mirror and walks away, forgetting what he saw, is the hearer who nods and does nothing. The deed is the test. Faith that stays in the head does not move the hands. The work proves what the words only claimed.
lessons.today: Before noon, take one clear instruction you already know and do it. Do not explain why it counts.
